rules.name: Secret or credential exposure
rules.message: Potential secret or credential handling detected. Require human review and redaction.

rules.name: Personal data exposure
rules.message: Potential sensitive personal data detected. Verify authorization and minimize exposure.

rules.name: High-risk or regulated request
rules.message: High-risk or regulated request detected. Require human review before execution or delivery.

rules.name: Unsupported external claim
rules.message: Potential unsupported claim detected. Verify evidence or rewrite conservatively.

rules.message: External delivery requires compliance and quality review before release.

rules.message: Evidence-sensitive request detected. Preserve sources and confidence level.
